ox.user.choose.description: Ask the user to pick one of 2-4 short labels or provide a short custom answer, then wait for their response: `await ox.user.choose({ purpose, body, options })`. Returns the chosen label or custom answer verbatim.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.user.follow.description: Show up to two likely next intents scoped to the current conversation above the empty composer without waiting for a response: `await ox.user.follow({ purpose, intents })`. Use `send` with a short label and the user message to send. Tapping any intent immediately sends its request. Collect any missing details in conversation afterward.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

ox.user.reportProgress.description: Post a concise progress update in the conversation without ending the run: `await ox.user.reportProgress({ purpose, message })`. Use it during longer multi-step work; later reasoning and actions continue below the update.
